request.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:CAPTAIN

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: ice-age folk of the frozen mountain peaks, calm and friendly. Their fixed colours: shaggy warm white and cream fur shaded with soft blue-grey, dark slate blue-grey skin, dark brown-grey hide and furs, pale ivory bone, and exactly one accent colour, a bright glacier ice blue with white highlights, only as small ice crystals, frost and ice shards.
layers.negative: red, crimson, gold, brass, orange, fire, flames, green, lime, purple, violet, magenta, pink, metal armour, steel, chrome, plate armour, medieval knight, helmet, sword, gun, scary, horror, realistic, large glowing area

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute unit figure with a big head, short sturdy body and one oversized signature weapon or tool, thick single-colour black outline, standing ready pose, both feet visible; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.

layers.text: Subject: Ice Witch, a chunky cute witch with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny body: a pale face with big friendly eyes and long straight white hair, a crown of tall sharp ice shards on her head; a long deep navy blue robe trimmed with white frost along the hem and the sleeves and a short white fur collar; a tall pale staff topped with one big ice crystal held up in one hand, and a few small white snowflakes swirling around her; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a witch of winter.
